description_en: Saves the verification result of a single file
description_zh: 保存单个文件的校验结果
name: VerifyFile

parameters.help_en: Complete JSON string information. For details, see the following information
parameters.help_zh: 完整JSON字符串信息，具体内容参见以下详细信息
parameters.name: json_str

Code.description_en: Result code. 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure. Callers can determine the failure reason using this field
Code.description_zh: 结果代码，200表示成功，若为别的值则表示失败，调用方可根据此字段判断失败原因

Data.description_en: Current detection accuracy: Number of incorrect characters in verified files / Total number of characters in verified files
Data.description_zh: 当前识别准确率：已校验过的文件错误字数/已校验过的文件总字数

Message.description_en: Error details when an error occurs. Successful when successful
Message.description_zh: 出错时表示出错详情，成功时为successful

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful. Callers can determine if the request was successful using this field: true indicates success; false/null indicates failure
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功，调用方可根据此字段来判断请求是否成功：true表示成功；false/null表示失败
